name: georgia-social-contributions
description: Social contributions in the country of Georgia (Sakartvelo, GE, currency GEL; not the US state) for tax year 2026: the funded pension under the Law of Georgia on Funded Pension, the only contribution levied on earnings. Covers who must join (employees, except those who were 60 or 55 before the Law), voluntary joining for older employees and the self-employed, the age-40 opt-out, the rates (employee 2%, employer 2%, self-employed 4%, state 2% on the first GEL 24,000 of the year's income and 1% up to GEL 60,000), the base, when contributions are paid, the GEL 300 fine and lost-benefit charge, the income tax treatment of contributions and payouts, foreigners and leaving Georgia. Trigger on: Georgia pension contribution, funded pension 2% Georgia, Pension Fund of Georgia, pensions.ge, self-employed pension Georgia 4%, social security Georgia. Out of scope: running a payroll (georgia-payroll), income tax (georgia-income-tax), VAT (georgia-vat).
